official.title: ChatGPT Plus 套餐与限制
official.text: Price: $20/month (billed monthly). Currently, we do not support annual billing or the option to pay for multiple months in advance for ChatGPT Plus subscriptions.

official.title: ChatGPT 与 API 的计费区别
official.text: API usage is billed separately from your ChatGPT subscription. ChatGPT subscriptions can be billed through the web, Apple App Store, or Google Play Store. Subscriptions on more than one platform may result in separate charges.
